chosen_working_standard.camera: Shared elevated three-quarter top-down artwork: visible top of head/shoulders and building bases, with readable face/torso/legs. Keep axis-aligned gameplay grid. Pose/facing may differ. No measured 3D camera angle claimed.
chosen_working_standard.light: Upper-left key light; top/left planes lighter, right/lower planes darker.
chosen_working_standard.outline: Dark one-screen-pixel-scale outer contour at game size; larger silhouettes permit limited interior dark separation. Avoid thick disconnected front-facing blocks.
chosen_working_standard.detail: Use Grunt readability and the existing tower/endpoint ground planes together as scene reference; simplify subpixel Rune engraving/sparks into stable clusters if refining Rune. Do not force every source to the same canvas dimensions.
chosen_working_standard.proportion: Opaque Rune/Grunt height ratio 1.50/.84 = 1.786, with .74 Runner and 1.02 Brute; presentation-only.

observed_mismatches.evidence: At the actual-size row and nearest details, Brute has an almost symmetric frontal shoulder bar, flat rectangular breastplate and straight front-on belt; Runner has a side-running limb silhouette with little visible crown/shoulder top plane. Their planes do not match the clearly receding stone bases or the Grunt three-quarter face.
observed_mismatches.action: Refine these two first using the complete shared scene, preserving identities, right-facing metadata and relative opaque heights.

observed_mismatches.evidence: Rune displayed crop is 98x160 reduced by 0.45 world pixels per source pixel; Grunt opaque height is 52 reduced by 0.7754. Rune retains much finer multi-color engraving/spark clusters than the Grunt. The 2x detail shows these dense interior flecks; resizing changes apparent density, not drawing perspective.
observed_mismatches.action: For a future Rune refinement, retain architecture/crystal/runic identity but use fewer larger deliberate clusters and align visible top/base planes to the shared elevated scene.

observed_mismatches.evidence: Arrow and Ballista source displayed heights are 86/89 at scales about .793/.755; their major wood/stone forms survive actual-size reduction more coherently than Rune160 at.45. Their bases and upper platforms supply the scene ground-plane reference.
observed_mismatches.action: Keep original art for this presentation pass; do not independently regenerate accepted towers merely to homogenize palettes.
